note: Issue 444, patrons.md section 6. A Respectable patron, the month after a town declares: he can no longer be associated with the colony, and his policies end with this letter, which is the warning policy.md section 4 requires. Anything the PC promised him still stands. Every declaration sends it again. Unskippable, because the policies end whether or not the PC hears of it and he must. Placeholder prose.

body.text: I have heard what {param:town} has done, and so, I am afraid, has everybody else.

You will understand that a man in my position cannot be seen doing business with a colony whose towns are declaring against the Crown. I have given instructions that my arrangements in the colony are to end with this letter.
What you undertook to me stands, and I shall expect it. I say that without warmth, which I regret, but I find I have none to spare this month.

options.text: and I beg you to think again
and I note how quickly you found it
